::: {.milestone-banner}
**Milestone — A factor risk model built from scratch.** [What makes it good](../milestones.qmd#m133)

::: {.why}
Four covariance estimators, a factor decomposition and a sizing decision, all built rather than called, and the document is graded on whether the simplest benchmark is still in the table.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Show the eigenvalue spectrum against the Marchenko-Pastur bound so it is visible which eigenvalues carry information.
- State what full Kelly implies, what fraction you will run, and the drawdown you are accepting.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Finish reports/milestone-04-risk-model.md: the four covariance estimates with the spectrum plotted against the theoretical bound, factor exposures and a risk decomposition of one portfolio into factor and idiosyncratic parts, the out-of-sample comparison with equal weighting present, and the sizing section with the Kelly fraction and its implied drawdown.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, nineteenth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 1.1 to the 7th and 0.9 to the 7th to three decimals.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Markov chains under a clock: a frog on a 5-lily-pad cycle jumps left or right with equal probability. Expected time to visit every pad? Then the stationary distribution if the jumps are 2 to 1 in one direction.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Expected value game, the kind that opens a trading interview: I roll a fair die and you may pay to see the result and then choose to reroll once, keeping the second. What is the game worth? Now with two rerolls, and say how you would compute it for n.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 4 closes the portfolio phase. qlib/risk.py and qlib/portfolio.py now hold the covariance estimators, the neutralisation, the volatility target and the sizing rule, and every signal built in phase 6 flows through them unchanged.
:::
